verdicts.reason: Both candidates break the design the same way. The S-A-L-E letters have come out of their four circles, which now sit empty in the centre. The letters are scattered over the right half (S and A in one column, L and E far right), so the main 'SALE' message no longer reads. 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' has moved to the top-left, away from the central focal stack, and the decorations are split into two separate clusters, losing the original's symmetry. The two differ only by a few pixels in headline size and letter position, so neither is meaningfully better.
